text: The access policy is signed off. Before any architecture gets planned, version one needs a hard line: which roles and which data ship now, and what gets deferred.

Ships in v1: the existing nightly claims export, the three roles from the policy, row- and column-level enforcement across all fifteen clinics, and a real per-user audit trail replacing the old shared login.

Deferred, not forgotten: a per-clinic exception role for Finance, sharing data with outside auditors, enriching claims with clinical records, and letting Compliance manage its own roster without an engineer.
When Finance asks for 'just one more exception' mid-build, there's already a fast answer: it's first on the list for next time.
Scope is locked. Next: choosing the actual platform that makes this policy enforceable.
